title: In the 2015/2016 season, which league had both the highest number of drawn
question: In the 2015/2016 season, which league had both the highest number of drawn matches and a maximum home-team goal score of at least 5? Return only the league name.

prediction.sql:
SELECT t2."XCL_005"
FROM Match AS t1
INNER JOIN League AS t2 ON t1."XCL_008" = t2."XCL_003"
WHERE t1."XCL_009" = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY t2."XCL_003", t2."XCL_005"
HAVING MAX(t1."XCL_015") >= 5
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN t1."XCL_015" = t1."XCL_016" THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 1
